description.en:
The call time. For example, to specify 8:30-12:00 and 13:30-19:00, pass [[8.5,12][13.5,19]].

If this parameter is not specified, the call time is not modified.

description.zh: 外呼时间
description.en: The call time.

The call time with minute-level precision. If both this parameter and CallTimeList are specified, this parameter takes precedence. Use this parameter for minute-level precision. For example, to specify 08:31-12:05 and 13:33-19:00, pass [["08:31","12:05"]["13:33","19:00"]]. Default value: [["08:00","20:00"]].

description.zh: 第一个调用时间字符串
description.en: The first call time string.

description.zh: 回调地址
description.en: The callback URL.

description.zh: 当发送闪信配置为1时，闪信模板ID必填
description.en: The flash SMS template ID. Required when the flash SMS configuration is set to 1.

description.zh: 发送闪信配置,默认为0,0不发送闪信.1发送闪信
description.en:
The flash SMS configuration. Default value: 0. Valid values:
- 0: do not send flash SMS.
- 1: send flash SMS.

description.zh:
并发数 修改并发数。默认为1，不可超过企业设置最高并发数；
注：不传参视为不修改
description.en:
The concurrency. Modifies the concurrency. Default value: 1. The value cannot exceed the maximum concurrency configured for the enterprise.

If this parameter is not specified, the concurrency is not modified.

description.zh:
任务名称 修改任务名称，不能超过100个字符；
注：不传参视为不修改；
description.en:
The task name. Modifies the task name. The name cannot exceed 100 characters.

If this parameter is not specified, the task name is not modified.

description.zh: 播放间隔时长
description.en: The playback interval duration.

description.zh: 录音播放次数
description.en: The recording playback count.

description.zh:
重呼配置 可选值：1，2，3，默认为1； 1：不重呼；2：间隔重呼；3：定时重呼；
注：不传参视为不修改；
description.en:
The recall configuration. Valid values:
- 1: no recall. This is the default value.
- 2: interval-based recall.
- 3: scheduled recall.

If this parameter is not specified, the recall configuration is not modified.

description.zh: 录音地址
description.en: The recording URL.

description.zh:
重呼次数 当重呼选项为2时，必填；支持≥1正整数
注：不传参视为不修改；
description.en:
The recall count. Required when the recall option is set to 2. The value must be a positive integer greater than or equal to 1.

If this parameter is not specified, the recall count is not modified.

description.zh:
重呼间隔 当重呼选项为2时，必填；单位为分钟，支持≥1的正整数
注：不传参视为不修改；
description.en:
The recall interval. Required when the recall option is set to 2. Unit: minutes. The value must be a positive integer greater than or equal to 1.

If this parameter is not specified, the recall interval is not modified.

description.zh: 重呼条件
description.en: The recall condition.

description.zh: 重呼时间
description.en: The recall time.

description.zh: 短信发送规则 设定挂机短信的发送规则，若为空，则视为不发送
description.en: The SMS sending rule. Specifies the rule for sending post-hangup SMS messages. If this parameter is empty, no SMS messages are sent.

description.zh: 意向标签
description.en: The intent labels.

description.zh: 短信模板ID
description.en: The SMS template ID.

description.zh:
任务状态 修改任务状态，2：开启；4：停止；
注：不传参视为不修改；
description.en:
The task status. Modifies the task status. Valid values:
- 2: started.
- 4: stopped.

If this parameter is not specified, the task status is not modified.

description.zh: 任务id
description.en: The task ID.

description.zh: 话术模板ID 注：不传参视为不修改；
description.en:
The script template ID.

If this parameter is not specified, the template ID is not modified.

description.zh:
话术模板类型 1：单模 版；2：智能话术策略模板；
注：不传参视为不修改
description.en:
The script templatetype. Valid values:
- 1: single-model template.
- 2: intelligent script Policy Template.

If you do not pass parameter, the templatetype is not modified.

description.zh: 外呼时间需要的按星期几进行外呼，例：[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]，代表周一到周日都外呼
description.en: The days of the week for outbound calls. Example: [1,2,3,4,5,6,7], which indicates outbound calls from Monday to Sunday.

descriptions.en: Edits a task in the industry edition.
